description:
Two-person team from Angeles City, Philippines. NASA's two fire sensors, MODIS and VIIRS, read the same ground and their records disagree. BRASA is a free, open-source web app. It folds 26 years of FIRMS active-fire detections into a burning calendar for any area you draw. We validated on years held out of training. Fire managers, land managers and scientists can use it to ask one narrow question: unusual month, or sensor switch inventing a surge?

Live: theexotech.github.io/brasa
